paragraphs.en: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. The total consumption of a task is therefore hard to predict before execution and the prediction must be revised as the run unfolds. In this paper, we propose TokenCast, which learns a composable cost representation for each execution segment, recording its own consumption and the context growth it introduces. Composing adjacent segments yields a cumulative estimate that captures the extra input cost incurred when context from earlier segments is re-read by every later call. As execution unfolds, newly observed evidence refreshes the forecast, requiring no additional LLM calls and incurring a mean cumulative prediction time of 32.8 ms per run on SWE-bench Verified. Across 4 task suites and 6 agent models, TokenCast’s mean absolute error reduction against the strongest comparator averages 14.5% over 96 evaluated combinations. In offline budget-control replay, TokenCast uses 21.3% fewer tokens on average than a fixed-budget policy at matched trace completion. The code is available at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/TokenCast .
paragraphs.zh: 当一个大语言模型（LLM）智能体执行同一任务时，不同运行过程中的令牌消耗量可能相差一个数量级以上。 智能体根据工具反馈和中间结果选择下一步行动，而不断增长的上下文会持续扩大后续每次调用的输入规模。 因此，在任务执行前很难预测其总消耗量，并且必须随着运行过程的发展不断更新预测值。 在本文中，我们提出了 TokenCast，它能够学习每个执行段的可组合成本表示，记录其自身的消耗量以及由此引发的上下文增长。 通过组合相邻的执行段，可以得出一个累积估计值，该值能够捕捉到早期执行段的上下文被后续每次调用重新读取时产生的额外输入成本。 随着执行过程推进，新观察到的证据会更新预测结果，这一过程无需额外的 LLM 调用，并且在 SWE-bench Verified 数据集上，每次运行的平均累积预测时间为 32.8 毫秒。 在 4 个任务套件和 6 个智能体模型中，TokenCast 与最强对比方法相比，其平均绝对误差的降低幅度在所有 96 种评估组合中平均为 14.5%。 在离线预算控制重播测试中，当完成相同轨迹时，TokenCast 的平均令牌使用量比固定预算策略减少了 21.3%。 代码可在 https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/TokenCast 获取。

paragraphs.en: The applications of large language models (LLMs) are expanding from simple question answering to complex tasks such as software engineering and deep research. Completing these tasks typically relies on LLM-based agents that repeatedly plan, modify code, invoke tools, and verify results ( DBLP:conf/iclr/YaoZYDSN023 ; DBLP:conf/nips/YangJWLYNP24 ; DBLP:conf/iclr/0001LSXTZPSLSTL25 ) . A given task may be resolved in a single edit or may require multiple rounds of retries before converging, and the dialogue and tool outputs generated in each round accumulate into the context of subsequent requests ( DBLP:conf/nips/YangJWLYNP24 ; DBLP:journals/pacmse/XiaoGPX26 ; zhu2026tracelab ) . The final token consumption of a task is therefore difficult to predict before execution completes, making it hard for users to forecast costs and plan usage ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的应用正在从简单的问答扩展到软件工程和深度研究等复杂任务。 完成这些任务通常依赖于基于 LLM 的智能体，它们会反复进行规划、修改代码、调用工具并验证结果（DBLP:conf/iclr/YaoZYDSN023 ; DBLP:conf/nips/YangJWLYNP24 ; DBLP:conf/iclr/0001LSXTZPSLSTL25）。 某个任务可能通过一次编辑即可解决，也可能需要多轮重试才能收敛，且每一轮中生成的对话和工具输出都会累积到后续请求的上下文中（DBLP:conf/nips/YangJWLYNP24 ; DBLP:journals/pacmse/XiaoGPX26 ; zhu2026tracelab）。 因此，在任务执行完成之前，很难预测其最终的令牌消耗量，这使得用户难以预估成本并规划使用（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750）。

paragraphs.en: The challenge of predicting tokens lies in the fact that every action an agent takes can trigger new model calls, and consumption across steps is interdependent: the longer the context left by earlier steps, the larger the input to every subsequent call, causing consumption to accumulate and amplify ( salim2026tokenomics ; zhu2026tracelab ; DBLP:journals/pacmse/XiaoGPX26 ) . The model’s generative behavior further compounds the difficulty. Given the same input, the model may choose different courses of action, generate outputs of different lengths, and consequently undergo different numbers of verification or retry cycles. In practice, token consumption across different executions of the same task can differ by up to 30 × \times ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 ) , making accurate prediction challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 预测标记的挑战在于，智能体的每一次操作都可能触发新的模型调用，且各步骤的资源消耗相互依赖：早期步骤留下的上下文越长，后续每次调用的输入就越大，导致消耗不断累积和放大（salim2026tokenomics；zhu2026tracelab；DBLP:journals/pacmse/XiaoGPX26）。 模型的生成行为进一步加剧了这一难题。 在相同输入下，模型可能会选择不同的行动路径，生成不同长度的输出，进而经历不同数量的验证或重试循环。 实际上，同一任务在不同执行中的标记消耗差异可能高达 30 × \times（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750），这使得准确预测变得困难。

paragraphs.en: Existing work can be organized by prediction scope and observation time. The scope ranges from a single response to an entire agent task; the forecast can be made before execution or updated during it. These dimensions give four settings (Figure 1 ): response length before generation, remaining response length during generation, total task consumption before execution, and remaining task consumption as an agent runs. Prior methods address these settings with different targets and access assumptions ( DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究可以根据预测范围和观察时间进行分类。 预测范围从单个响应到整个智能体任务不等；预测可以在执行前做出，也可以在执行过程中更新。 这些维度形成了四种设置（图 1）：生成前的响应长度、生成过程中的剩余响应长度、执行前的总任务消耗量，以及智能体运行时的剩余任务消耗量。 先前的方法针对这些设置提出了不同的目标和访问假设（DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750）。

paragraphs.en: At the request level, prior work studies how to predict the response length of a single model call. Because the input is known before generation begins, these methods typically estimate length from input features for resource allocation ( DBLP:conf/nips/JinW0W23 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2404-08509 ; fu2024efficient ; zheng2026scheduling ) , while some also refine the estimate during generation using intermediate states or entropy statistics ( DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2607-05316 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在请求层面，先前的工作研究了如何预测单次模型调用的响应长度。 由于输入在生成开始前已知，这些方法通常根据输入特征估算长度以分配资源（DBLP:conf/nips/JinW0W23；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2404-08509；fu2024efficient；zheng2026scheduling），而一些方法则在生成过程中利用中间状态或熵统计量进一步优化估算结果（DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2607-05316）。

paragraphs.en: At the agent-task level, prior work estimates total token consumption before execution, either from the task description or through the model’s own cost assessment ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 ) . Multi-step LLM execution frameworks organize or schedule requests according to program structures, semantic dependencies, or workflow paths available before the corresponding requests are executed ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2310-03714 ; DBLP:conf/osdi/LinHZ00CQ24 ; DBLP:conf/nips/ZhengYXS0YCKSGB24 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2603-22206 ; yu2026pythia ) . Open-ended agents present a different situation: their behavior depends on tool feedback, environment state, and intermediate results, and no complete dependency graph exists before execution begins ( DBLP:conf/iclr/YaoZYDSN023 ; DBLP:conf/nips/YangJWLYNP24 ; DBLP:conf/iclr/0001LSXTZPSLSTL25 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体-任务层面，先前的研究通过任务描述或模型自身的成本评估来估算执行前的总令牌消耗量（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750）。 多步骤 LLM 执行框架会根据程序结构、语义依赖关系或在相应请求执行前可用的工作流路径来组织或调度请求（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2310-03714；DBLP:conf/osdi/LinHZ00CQ24；DBLP:conf/nips/ZhengYXS0YCKSGB24；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2603-22206；yu2026pythia）。 开放式智能体则呈现出不同的情况：其行为取决于工具反馈、环境状态和中间结果，并且在执行开始前并不存在完整的依赖图（DBLP:conf/iclr/YaoZYDSN023；DBLP:conf/nips/YangJWLYNP24；DBLP:conf/iclr/0001LSXTZPSLSTL25）。

paragraphs.en: Multi-step forecasting has also been studied in structured workflows ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2603-22206 ) . We focus on remaining provider-accounted input and output consumption in sequential agent execution. Each future request can bill retained context again, coupling the remaining cost to both future call count and input lengths. TokenCast updates this forecast from observed execution information without querying an LLM for the cost estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 多步预测也已在结构化工作流中得到了研究（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2603-22206）。 我们关注的是在智能体顺序执行过程中，由提供者负责计算的剩余输入和输出消耗。 每次未来的请求都可能再次对保留的上下文进行计费，从而将剩余成本与未来的调用次数和输入长度都关联起来。 TokenCast 通过已观察到的执行信息更新这一预测，而无需向 LLM 查询成本估算。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes TokenCast. It represents each execution segment by call count, net input-length change, and a cost residual. An exact composition identity exposes how context growth in one segment affects the cost baseline of later calls. The task predictor combines a direct forecast with a prefix–suffix forecast conditioned on a predicted boundary state, and refreshes its features as execution proceeds. Calibrated quantile models provide prediction intervals. The predictor makes no additional LLM calls.

paragraphs.en: Request-level output length prediction. Early methods extract features from the prompt to estimate response length for memory reservation, batching, or shortest-job-first scheduling ( DBLP:conf/nips/JinW0W23 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2404-08509 ) . Prompt-only estimates remain highly uncertain, and prompt-conditioned response lengths can exhibit broad or heavy-tailed distributions ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2505-16881 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-07931 ) . Subsequent work therefore models more than a single point estimate: one line of work learns pairwise length orderings among requests to set scheduling priorities ( fu2024efficient ) , and another fits a heavy-tailed log- t t distribution that lets the scheduler trade off average and tail latency ( zheng2026scheduling ) . Once generation begins, the decoder’s own intermediate states become available. Several recent studies show that mid-layer representations or entropy statistics can continuously refine the remaining-length estimate during decoding, narrowing the gap between the initial guess and the actual length ( DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2607-05316 ; DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812 ) . These methods share a common set of assumptions: the prediction target is a single response, the prompt is known, and the system has access to the prompt or to model internals. In agent tasks, later requests do not exist until earlier actions and tool calls complete, so none of these assumptions holds.
paragraphs.zh: 请求级别的输出长度预测。 早期方法从提示中提取特征，以估计响应长度，用于内存预留、批量处理或最短作业优先调度（DBLP:conf/nips/JinW0W23；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2404-08509）。 仅基于提示的估计仍存在高度不确定性，且受提示条件影响的响应长度可能呈现宽分布或重尾分布（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2505-16881；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-07931）。 因此，后续研究不再仅建模单个点估计值：一类工作通过学习请求之间的成对长度排序来设定调度优先级（fu2024efficient），另一类工作则拟合重尾的 log-t 分布，使调度器能够在平均延迟和尾部延迟之间进行权衡（zheng2026scheduling）。 一旦生成开始，解码器自身的中间状态便可用。 多项近期研究表明，在解码过程中，中间层的表示或熵统计量可以持续优化剩余长度的估计值，从而缩小初始猜测与实际长度之间的差距（DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2607-05316；DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812）。 这些方法共享一组共同的假设：预测目标是单个响应，提示是已知的，且系统能够访问提示或模型内部状态。 在智能体任务中，后续请求在早期动作和工具调用完成之前并不存在，因此上述假设均不成立。

paragraphs.en: An agent executes a task through a sequence of LLM calls interleaved with tool interactions. Let C k C_{k} denote the provider-accounted input and output token consumption of call k k . A task terminates upon completion, failure, or when an execution limit is reached. For a task with K K calls, its total consumption is T = ∑ j = 1 K C j T=\sum_{j=1}^{K}C_{j} . After call k k completes, the confirmed consumption is S k = ∑ j = 1 k C j S_{k}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}C_{j} , and the remaining consumption is R k = T − S k R_{k}=T-S_{k} . Each forecast uses only the task and execution information available at its prediction point.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过一系列穿插工具交互的 LLM 调用来执行任务。 令 C k C_{k} 表示提供商统计的第 k k 次调用的输入和输出令牌消耗量。 任务在完成、失败或达到执行限制时终止。 对于一个包含 K K 次调用的任务，其总消耗量为 T = ∑ j = 1 K C j T=\sum_{j=1}^{K}C_{j} 。 第 k k 次调用完成后，确认的消耗量为 S k = ∑ j = 1 k C j S_{k}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}C_{j} ，剩余消耗量为 R k = T − S k R_{k}=T-S_{k} 。 每次预测仅使用在预测时刻可用的任务和执行信息。

paragraphs.en: Updating forecasts. Each completed step during execution produces new observations, and TokenCast refreshes its forecasts accordingly. At Call Start, the current request has been assembled and the actual input length is known, so the call-level forecast can be based on it directly. At In-call Update, the committed generated prefix and streaming timing supply additional features for the current-call forecast. At Task Update, the completed call supplies confirmed cumulative cost S k S_{k} and any completed tool outcomes. The next request’s input length remains predicted until that request is assembled. paragraphs.en: Tasks and execution traces. We evaluate TokenCast on SWE-bench Verified ( DBLP:conf/iclr/JimenezYWYPPN24 ; chowdhury2024swebenchverified ) , Search-R1 ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2503-09516 ) , MMLU-Pro ( DBLP:conf/nips/WangMZNCGRAHJLK24 ) , and LongBench-v2 ( DBLP:conf/acl/BaiTZ0WLCX0D0L25 ) , covering software engineering, retrieval-based question answering, knowledge-based reasoning, and long-context understanding. We collect 11,712 execution traces from 240 benchmark tasks with six agent LLMs: GPT-5.4 ( openai2026gpt54 ) , Claude Opus 4.6 ( anthropic2026claudeopus46 ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro ( googledeepmind2026gemini31pro ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( deepseekai2026deepseekv4 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( qwen38 ) , and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct ( meta2024llama32 ) . For reproducibility, we specify gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 for the GPT-5.4 API and qwen3.8-27b-20260815 for the self-hosted Qwen checkpoint; Table 5 lists model access and reasoning configurations. Traces are collected using DeepSeek Harness ( deepseekharness ) and OpenHands ( DBLP:conf/iclr/0001LSXTZPSLSTL25 ) . Repeated executions support the analysis of run-to-run variation, with additional repeats for anchor tasks. Table 2 specifies the collection design for each benchmark and harness. All runs of the same task remain in one partition. Training, validation, calibration, and test tasks are separated as described in Appendix C . Generalization experiments also use independently released trajectories (Appendix C.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare TokenCast with three output-length predictors, TRAIL ( DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25 ) , EGTP ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812 ) , and TIE ( zheng2026scheduling ) , and the agent-level consumption estimator Self-Prediction ( DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 ) . We adapt these methods to the prediction targets and observations available at the four prediction points. At Task Start, Self-Prediction inspects the task environment before estimating total consumption. At the other prediction points, it uses the observed execution prefix. Appendix C.3 details each adaptation. Appendix D.6 compares direct regression, compositional forecasting, their average, and the full correction pipeline; Appendix D.6 evaluates the segment representation and composition procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们将 TokenCast 与三种输出长度预测方法进行比较：TRAIL（DBLP:conf/iclr/ShahoutMLJYM25）、EGTP（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2602-11812）和 TIE（zheng2026scheduling），以及智能体级别的消耗估计方法 Self-Prediction（DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750）。 我们将这些方法适配到四个预测点所可用的预测目标和观测数据上。 在任务开始时，Self-Prediction 会在估算总消耗之前检查任务环境。 在其他预测点，它则使用已观测到的执行前缀。 附录 C.3 详细说明了每种适配方法。 附录 D.6 比较了直接回归、组合式预测、二者的平均值以及完整的校正流程；附录 D.6 还评估了分段表示和组合过程。

paragraphs.en: Metrics and implementation. We report mean absolute error (MAE) and weighted absolute percentage error (WAPE) at the four prediction points. At Call Start, the target includes the assembled request’s known input tokens. For 90% prediction intervals, we report empirical coverage, mean width, and mean interval score (MIS) ( gneiting2007strictly ) . Tasks receive equal weight, with that weight distributed across their runs and evaluated checkpoints. Cross-configuration summaries divide MAE by that of a history-median predictor, which outputs the median training target for the same benchmark, agent LLM, and prediction point. The local platform provides eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Internal-state baselines use the agent model when accessible and a proxy for API-based models. Appendix C gives metrics, data partitions, training settings, and timing procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 指标与实现。 我们在四个预测点上报告平均绝对误差（MAE）和加权绝对百分比误差（WAPE）。 在“调用开始”阶段，目标包括已组装请求中已知的输入词元。 对于 90% 的预测区间，我们报告经验覆盖度、平均宽度以及平均区间得分（MIS）（gneiting2007strictly）。 各项任务具有相等的权重，该权重会分配给它们的运行和评估的检查点。 跨配置摘要通过将 MAE 除以历史中位数预测器的 MAE 来计算得出；该预测器针对相同的基准、智能体 LLM 和预测点输出训练目标的中位数。 本地平台提供八块 NVIDIA A100 GPU。 内部状态基线在可用时使用智能体模型，对于基于 API 的模型则使用代理模型。 附录 C 提供了指标、数据分区、训练设置和时间流程。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows SWE-bench Verified and Search-R1 results for GPT-5.4 and Qwen3.8-27B; Figure 3 covers all four benchmarks and six agent LLMs. On SWE-bench Verified with GPT-5.4, TokenCast reduces MAE relative to the strongest comparator by 47.9% at In-call Update, from EGTP’s 74.6 to 38.9 tokens, and by 30.4% at Task Update, from TRAIL’s 115k to 80k tokens. At Task Start, the strongest comparator is Self-Prediction, and the reduction is 5.3%, from 152k to 144k tokens. Across the 96 benchmark–model–prediction-point combinations in Appendix D.2 , its MAE reduction against the lowest comparator MAE averages 14.5%. The averages are − 2.2 % -2.2\% at Task Start, 1.9 % 1.9\% at Call Start, 30.4 % 30.4\% at In-call Update, and 27.8 % 27.8\% at Task Update. TokenCast trails the strongest comparator in 24 combinations: 15 at Task Start and nine at Call Start. None of these losses occurs at In-call Update or Task Update, where execution evidence accumulates.
paragraphs.zh: 表1展示了GPT-5.4和Qwen3.8-27B在SWE-bench Verified和Search-R1上的结果；图3涵盖了全部四个基准测试和六个智能体LLM。 在GPT-5.4的SWE-bench Verified测试中，TokenCast在“调用内更新”阶段相对于最强对比模型将MAE降低了47.9%，从EGTP的74.6个token降至38.9个token；在“任务更新”阶段则降低了30.4%，从TRAIL的11.5万个token降至8万个token。 在“任务开始”阶段，最强对比模型是Self-Prediction，TokenCast的MAE减少了5.3%，从15.2万个token降至14.4万个token。 在附录D.2中列出的96种基准测试–模型–预测点的组合中，TokenCast相对于最低对比模型MAE的平均降幅为14.5%。 各阶段的平均值分别为：“任务开始”阶段−2.2%，“调用开始”阶段1.9%，“调用内更新”阶段30.4%，“任务更新”阶段27.8%。 在24种组合中，TokenCast的表现弱于最强对比模型：其中15种出现在“任务开始”阶段，9种出现在“调用开始”阶段。 这些性能损失均未出现在“调用内更新”或“任务更新”阶段，因为这两个阶段会积累执行证据。

paragraphs.en: TokenCast’s forecasts are revised as execution unfolds. In a code-repair run, a verification failure raises the task-total forecast, which decreases after a compatibility workaround passes the reported assertions. In long-context QA, file operations after answer generation consume further tokens and raise the forecast. Both traces are in Appendix E . We next examine token-budget control driven by these online forecasts on SWE-bench Verified.
paragraphs.zh: TokenCast 的预测会随着执行过程而进行修订。 在一次代码修复运行中，验证失败会提高任务总预测值，而在兼容性变通方案通过所报告的断言后，该预测值则会下降。 在长上下文问答中，答案生成后的文件操作会消耗更多 token，并导致预测值上升。 这两条轨迹均见附录 E。 接下来，我们将研究这些在线预测在 SWE-bench Verified 上所驱动的 token 预算控制机制。

paragraphs.en: Budget control. paragraphs.en: TokenCast addresses the problem of forecasting token consumption during LLM agent execution, where context accumulation causes each call’s cost to depend on the entire preceding trajectory. The method represents each execution segment with a composable cost triple that separates the starting-input baseline from incremental consumption, and composes adjacent segments to propagate context growth into downstream cost estimates. Across four benchmarks and six agent LLMs, TokenCast’s MAE reduction against the strongest comparator averages 14.5% over 96 evaluated combinations and, in offline budget-control replay, it matches a fixed budget’s trace-completion rate while consuming 21.3% fewer tokens. Its mean cumulative task-level prediction time is 32.8 ms per run on SWE-bench Verified. Because the predictors are learned from recorded traces, transfer to a new task domain or agent LLM improves with a small set of target tasks from the new setting. This work provides a lightweight prediction layer for agent token consumption, and we leave the integration of these forecasts into a runtime decision framework that actively manages execution under budget constraints as a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: TokenCast 解决了 LLM 智能体执行过程中预测令牌消耗量的问题：由于上下文不断累积，每次调用的成本都取决于此前完整的执行轨迹。 该方法用可组合的成本三元组表示每个执行段，将初始输入基准与增量消耗分离开来，并通过组合相邻的执行段，将上下文的增长传递到下游的成本估算中。 在四个基准测试和六个智能体 LLM 上，TokenCast 相较于最强对比方法的 MAE 平均降低了 14.5%（基于 96 种评估组合）；在离线预算控制重播实验中，它在消耗令牌数量减少 21.3% 的同时，仍能匹配固定预算下的轨迹完成率。 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，其任务级别的平均累计预测时间为每次运行 32.8 毫秒。 由于这些预测模型是从记录好的轨迹中学习得到的，因此只需少量来自新环境的目标任务，即可将其成功迁移到新的任务领域或智能体 LLM。 这项工作为智能体的令牌消耗提供了一层轻量级的预测机制；而将这些预测结果整合到一个能够在预算约束下主动管理执行的运行时决策框架中，则留待未来研究。

Token usage comes from provider records, and a logical call aggregates its initial request and any retries. The input length of an assembled request is measured directly; a future request’s input length remains predicted until assembly. The visible prefix contains streamed text and tool-call arguments committed so far, with a checkpoint every 128 UTF-8 bytes. Unavailable fields are masked. Prediction-point observations remain separate from the prefix-ending predictions passed to the suffix model.
paragraphs.zh: 观察记录 𝐯 \mathbf{v} 仅包含预测时刻可用的信息。 Token 使用量来自提供商记录，一次逻辑调用会汇总其初始请求及任何重试。 已组合请求的输入长度可直接测量；未来请求的输入长度在组合前仍为预测值。 可见前缀包含至此已提交的流式文本和工具调用参数，并以每 128 UTF-8 字节设置一个检查点。 不可用的字段会被掩码处理。 预测时刻的观察结果与传递给后缀模型的前缀结尾预测保持分离。

paragraphs.en: Action types. Reads include file reads, glob matches, and searches. Edits write or replace file content. Tracking updates the to-do list. A shell command is labeled as a test when it invokes pytest, tox, nox, or unittest, or refers to a test directory, and other shell commands are labeled as runs. An action is marked as failed when a tool reports an error or a shell command exits with a nonzero status. The stage of a call is determined by its most recent action.
paragraphs.zh: 操作类型。 读取操作包括文件读取、glob 匹配和搜索。 编辑操作会写入或替换文件内容。 跟踪操作会更新待办事项列表。 当某个 shell 命令调用 pytest、tox、nox 或 unittest，或引用测试目录时，该命令会被标记为测试；其他 shell 命令则被标记为运行。 当工具报告错误或 shell 命令以非零状态退出时，该操作会被标记为失败。 调用的阶段由其最近一次操作决定。

paragraphs.en: Execution history. The progress record contains the numbers of planned, completed, and remaining to-do items, together with the number of calls since the list was last updated. The consumption history contains the input, output, and reasoning usage of the latest completed call, their changes from the preceding call, their mean, median, and least-squares trends over the last five and ten calls, and running totals of calls, model requests, tool actions, and confirmed tokens. Task Update additionally records the numbers of failed requests and tool errors in the latest call, together with the numbers of consecutive calls that failed, required a retry, or made no progress. Progress is defined as an edit, test, tracking update, or completed plan item. A window statistic is masked when the required observations are unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 执行历史。 进度记录包含已计划、已完成和待完成待办事项的数量，以及自列表上次更新以来的调用次数。 消耗记录包含最近一次已完成调用的输入、输出和推理使用量，这些指标与前一次调用的变化，以及过去五次和十次调用中的平均值、中位数和最小二乘趋势，还有调用、模型请求、工具操作和确认标记的累计总数。 任务更新还记录了最近一次调用中的失败请求和工具错误数量，以及连续失败、需要重试或没有进展的调用次数。 进度定义为一次编辑、测试、跟踪更新或已完成的计划项。 当所需的观察数据不可用时，窗口统计信息会被隐藏。

paragraphs.en: Recent tool actions. The w w most recent tool actions fill the slots in recency order. Each slot records the action type, status, result size, calls since execution, and the reported result: an exit code, the number of lines returned by a read, the number of matches returned by a search, or the passed and failed counts of a test run. sents.zh: 近期的工具操作。

paragraphs.en: Generated prefix. The lowercased prefix is hashed by words and word pairs into 256 signed buckets with weight 1 + log ⁡ n 1+\log n for n n occurrences, and its last line is hashed into 64 buckets. A single scan records whether the prefix is a valid JSON prefix, its nesting depth, whether it ends inside a string and under which tool-argument key, and, within string contents, unmatched brackets, quote parity, open code fences, heredocs, and the termination pattern of the last line.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的前缀。 小写化的前缀通过单词和词对哈希到 256 个带符号的桶中，权重为 1 + log ⁡ n 1+\log n（其中 n 为其出现次数），其最后一行则被哈希到 64 个桶中。 单次扫描会记录该前缀是否为有效的 JSON 前缀、其嵌套深度、它是否结束于字符串内部以及位于哪个工具参数键下，以及在字符串内容中是否存在未匹配的括号、引号奇偶性、未闭合的代码围栏、 heredocs 以及最后一行的终止模式。

sents.zh: 生成的前缀。

paragraphs.en: Prefix recall. Earlier completed model requests from the same run serve as references, each represented by its hashed prefix at every checkpoint and its final generated length. The current prefix is compared with these references using cosine similarity, and the record includes the final and remaining lengths associated with the most similar requests and checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀回忆。 同一运行中先前完成模型请求可作为参考，每个请求在每个检查点都由其哈希化前缀和最终生成的长度表示。 当前前缀通过余弦相似度与这些参考进行比较，记录中包含与最相似请求和检查点相关的最终长度和剩余长度。

sents.zh: 前缀回忆。

sents.en: Earlier completed model requests from the same run serve as references, each represented by its hashed prefix at every checkpoint and its final generated length.
sents.zh: 同一运行中先前完成模型请求可作为参考，每个请求在每个检查点都由其哈希化前缀和最终生成的长度表示。

paragraphs.en: Stream timing. For the current request, let s s denote its start time and let c 1 < ⋯ < c m c_{1}<\cdots<c_{m} denote the output-checkpoint times. The timing record contains the time to the first checkpoint c 1 − s c_{1}-s , elapsed time c m − s c_{m}-s , streaming time c m − c 1 c_{m}-c_{1} , committed bytes divided by streaming time, time since the previous checkpoint, the longest gap between checkpoints, and the initial-delay fraction ( c 1 − s ) / ( c m − s ) (c_{1}-s)/(c_{m}-s) . Fields with undefined denominators or too few observations are masked.
paragraphs.zh: 流式处理时间。 对于当前请求，令 s 表示其开始时间，令 c₁ < ⋯ < cₘ 表示输出检查点的时间。 时间记录包含到第一个检查点的时间 c₁ − s、经过的时间 cₘ − s、流式处理时间 cₘ − c₁、已提交字节数与流式处理时间的比值、自上次检查点以来的时间、检查点之间的最长间隔，以及初始延迟比例 (c₁ − s)/(cₘ − s)。 分母未定义或观测值过少的字段会被掩码。

sents.en: Stream timing.
sents.zh: 流式处理时间。

sents.en: For the current request, let s s denote its start time and let c 1 < ⋯ < c m c_{1}<\cdots<c_{m} denote the output-checkpoint times.
sents.zh: 对于当前请求，令 s 表示其开始时间，令 c₁ < ⋯ < cₘ 表示输出检查点的时间。

paragraphs.en: Predictors. TokenCast uses separate LightGBM models for the four prediction settings. Call Start and In-call Update predict the complete consumption of the current call. Task Start and Task Update use a direct path and a compositional path. The direct path predicts remaining task consumption as one target. The compositional path predicts the current or next segment, its ending boundary, and the subsequent suffix, then combines the two segment representations using Eq. ( 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 预测器。 TokenCast 为四种预测设置分别使用独立的 LightGBM 模型。 Call Start 和 In-call Update 用于预测当前通话的完整消耗量。 Task Start 和 Task Update 采用直接路径和组合路径。 直接路径将剩余任务消耗作为一个目标进行预测。 组合路径会预测当前或下一个分段、其结束边界以及随后的后缀，然后使用公式 (1) 结合这两个分段的表示。

sents.en: Predictors.
sents.zh: 预测器。

sents.en: TokenCast uses separate LightGBM models for the four prediction settings.
sents.zh: TokenCast 为四种预测设置分别使用独立的 LightGBM 模型。

sents.en: Call Start and In-call Update predict the complete consumption of the current call.
sents.zh: Call Start 和 In-call Update 用于预测当前通话的完整消耗量。

sents.zh: Task Start 和 Task Update 采用直接路径和组合路径。

sents.zh: 直接路径将剩余任务消耗作为一个目标进行预测。

Task-level instances contain the remaining-consumption target, the prefix representation and ending boundary, and the suffix representation. Model inputs contain only the evidence available at the corresponding prediction point.

sents.zh: 训练实例。

paragraphs.en: Task-level fitting. The direct and prefix models are fitted first. Task-level cross-fitting then produces out-of-fold prefix boundaries for suffix training. The suffix residual label is recomputed against the predicted input baseline as described in Section 3.3 . After these models are fixed, the complete pipeline produces out-of-fold forecasts used to fit the correction model in Eq. ( 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Task packs. A task is a statement and a seed workspace. For SWE-bench, the seed is the repository at the base commit. The agent may not edit tests and finishes by writing submission.patch , the diff of its working tree. For the other benchmarks, the seed holds README.md and an empty answer.md , the statement provides the question and its options, for LongBench-v2 together with the context document, and the agent writes its answer into answer.md . A Search-R1 statement also names a shell command that queries a local BM25 server [ robertson2009probabilistic , DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2503-09516 ] , the official Search-R1 retriever over the 21,015,324-passage wiki-18 corpus, and prints three passages. Correctness is scored after collection, with the SWE-bench Verified harness for patches, letter match for MMLU-Pro and LongBench-v2, and alias match for Search-R1.

paragraphs.en: Output-length predictors. TRAIL, EGTP, and TIE are originally designed to predict the length of a single response. We adapt each method to the target associated with a prediction point while preserving its core representation and estimator. For Qwen3.8-27B and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, the internal-state methods read the last layer of the agent LLM itself. For the API models, they use Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct as a proxy encoder over the text visible at the prediction point: the task statement at Task Start, the statement and transcript of completed calls at Call Start and Task Update, and the statement and generated prefix at In-call Update. The window keeps the first 384 tokens of the statement and the last 1,536 of the remaining text. TRAIL classifies the last-token state into 8 log-spaced target-length bins and predicts the expected bin median. EGTP fits a ridge regression of log target length on the entropy-weighted mean state and entropy statistics of the window. TIE encodes the window with bge-small-en-v1.5 [ DBLP:conf/sigir/XiaoLZMLN24 ] and fits the location and scale of a log- t t distribution with 3.5 degrees of freedom on the concatenated CLS, mean, and max poolings. Its point prediction is the median, and its interval spans the 0.05 and 0.95 quantiles.
paragraphs.zh: 输出长度预测器。 TRAIL、EGTP 和 TIE 最初被设计用于预测单个响应的长度。 我们在保留其核心表示和估计器的同时，将每种方法适配到与预测点相关的目标上。 对于 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，内部状态方法会读取智能体 LLM 自身最后一层的状态。 对于 API 模型，它们使用 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 作为预测点处可见文本的代理编码器：在任务开始时使用任务说明，在调用开始和任务更新时使用说明和已完成调用的记录，以及在调用内更新时使用说明和生成的前缀。 该窗口保留说明的前 384 个词元以及剩余文本的最后 1,536 个词元。 TRAIL 将最后一个词元的状态分类到 8 个对数均匀分布的目标长度区间中，并预测预期区间的中位数。 EGTP 基于熵加权平均状态和窗口的熵统计量，对目标长度的对数进行岭回归拟合。 TIE 使用 bge-small-en-v1.5 [ DBLP:conf/sigir/XiaoLZMLN24 ] 对窗口进行编码，并在拼接后的 CLS、均值和最大池化结果上拟合自由度为 3.5 的对数 t 分布的位置和尺度。 其点预测为中位数，其预测区间则覆盖 0.05 和 0.95 分位数。

paragraphs.en: We use the publicly released LiveClawBench trajectories [ long2026liveclawbench ] , which contain tasks from 10 application domains executed under a shared agent framework. For each agent LLM, we perform leave-one-domain-out evaluation, treating one domain as the unseen task type and training on the remaining domains. Zero-shot transfer uses no trajectories from the held-out domain. For adaptation, we add k k held-out-domain tasks to the training set and evaluate on the remaining held-out tasks. The target-only baseline is trained on the same k k tasks without source-domain data. All runs of a task remain in one partition. Relative to Self-Prediction, zero-shot MAE is 1.31 at Call Start and 1.47 at Task Update. With 10 target tasks, the ratios fall to 0.86 and 0.91; with 20, they reach 0.82 and 0.85. The trajectory-selection criteria are in Appendix C.1 .

paragraphs.en: We hold out each agent LLM in turn and train on trajectories from the remaining models under a shared task-collection and agent framework. Adaptation uses k k tasks executed by the held-out model, with task partitions shared across models and adaptation tasks disjoint from the test tasks. At Call Start, zero-shot MAE is 1.02 times the target history median; this ratio falls to 0.96 with 10 target-model tasks and 0.95 with 20. With 3–10 tasks, the transferred predictor achieves lower MAE than training on the same target-model tasks alone. Figure 7 also reports an auxiliary Task Update evaluation of remaining output tokens, a different target from total remaining consumption. Its normalized MAE ranges from 1.01 to 1.07 with up to 20 target-model tasks and reaches 0.98 when all target-model tasks are available. The target-only predictor starts at 1.22 with three tasks and approaches the history median as additional target-model trajectories are provided.
paragraphs.zh: 我们依次保留每个智能体 LLM，并在共享的任务收集与智能体框架下，使用其余模型生成的轨迹进行训练。 自适应过程使用被保留模型执行的 k 个任务，其中任务划分在各模型间共享，而自适应任务与测试任务互不重叠。 在调用开始时，零样本 MAE 是目标历史中位数的 1.02 倍；随着加入 10 个目标模型任务，该比率降至 0.96，加入 20 个任务时则降至 0.95。 当任务数量为 3–10 个时，迁移后的预测器实现的 MAE 低于仅使用相同目标模型任务进行训练的结果。 图 7 还报告了一项辅助的“任务更新”评估，关注其余输出词元，这与总剩余消耗量是不同的目标。 在最多使用 20 个目标模型任务时，其归一化 MAE 范围在 1.01 到 1.07 之间；当所有目标模型任务均可用时，该值达到 0.98。 仅使用目标任务的预测器在三个任务时初始 MAE 为 1.22，随着提供更多目标模型的轨迹，其值逐渐接近历史中位数。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate a shift in GPT-5.4’s reasoning configuration by rerunning the same 69 SWE-bench Verified tasks with reasoning effort set to off and comparing them with the corresponding runs under the low setting. Median run consumption decreases from 273k to 238k tokens. When trained and evaluated within the off configuration, TokenCast reduces MAE relative to Self-Prediction by 20.7% at Call Start, 50.8% at In-call Update, and 32.2% at Task Update (Table 14 ). We also transfer the predictor trained under the low configuration directly to the off configuration and adapt it using 20 target-configuration tasks. paragraphs.en: We measure the prediction overhead of refreshing the Task Update forecast at different intervals on SWE-bench Verified with GPT-5.4. Starting from the same initial forecast, the 1-, 3-, and 5-call settings refresh the prediction after every 1, 3, or 5 completed calls, respectively, and End makes only the initial forecast. At skipped checkpoints, the latest forecast of final task consumption is retained, the tokens confirmed so far are subtracted, and the remaining estimate is clipped at zero.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SWE-bench Verified 数据集上，使用 GPT-5.4 测量了以不同时间间隔刷新任务更新预测所带来的预测开销。 从相同的初始预测开始，1 次、3 次和 5 次调用设置分别在每个调用完成之后刷新预测一次，而“结束”模式仅执行初始预测。 在跳过的检查点处，会保留最新的最终任务消耗预测值，减去目前已确认的令牌数，并将剩余估计值截断至零。

paragraphs.en: Prediction strategy. At Task Start, no segment has finished, so the prefix–suffix decomposition has no observed anchor. The compositional path has a normalized MAE of 0.87, compared with 0.82 for direct regression. At Task Update, observed segment boundaries provide information about the input baseline and context growth. The compositional path improves to 0.66, below direct regression’s 0.72. Averaging the two paths reduces MAE to 0.81 at Task Start and 0.64 at Task Update. The correction model uses the direct and compositional forecasts together with the predicted boundary variables, reducing these values to 0.80 and 0.62, with 90.6% coverage (Table 17 ). paragraphs.en: Replay and stopping rules. We replay 288 GPT-5.4 runs from 144 SWE-bench Verified tasks, with two recorded runs per task. Seven budgets are defined by the 0.3 to 0.9 quantiles of recorded run consumption. At each Task Update checkpoint, the controller adds confirmed consumption to a selected quantile of predicted remaining consumption and stops the run when the sum exceeds the budget. A replay is trace-complete if it reaches its recorded terminal state. For each method, budget, and test fold, the controller selects the 0.05, 0.5, or 0.95 forecast quantile on runs outside the test fold, choosing the one using the fewest tokens while reaching at least the fixed-budget trace-completion rate. Results are pooled over out-of-fold test runs and averaged over three split seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 重播与停止规则。 我们对 144 个 SWE-bench 已验证任务中的 288 次 GPT-5.4 运行进行重播，每个任务记录两次运行。 通过记录运行消耗量的 0.3 至 0.9 分位数定义了七种预算。 在每个任务更新检查点，控制器将已确认的消耗量加到预测剩余消耗量的选定分位数上，当总和超过预算时停止运行。 如果重播达到了其记录的终端状态，则视为完全追溯。 对于每种方法、预算和测试折，控制器会选择测试折之外运行的 0.05、0.5 或 0.95 预测分位数，并选择使用最少令牌且至少达到固定预算追溯完成率的分位数。 结果基于折外测试运行汇总，并在三个分割种子上进行平均。

paragraphs.en: Cost accounting. A controller-stopped run is charged the consumption recorded at its stopping checkpoint. A run that finishes before the fixed cap is charged its recorded total; otherwise it is stopped at the cap, with wall time scaled by the recorded token progress. Prediction processing and time are included in the replay accounting. For encoder-based baselines, prediction tokens count locally processed text; Self-Prediction’s count includes additional provider-recorded LLM usage. Savings are relative to the fixed-budget strategy at the same budget. Table 20 lists the complete results, Figure 8 shows the budget-wise response, and Table 21 compares prediction overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 成本核算。 由控制器终止的运行将按其在终止检查点记录的消费量进行收费。 在达到固定上限之前完成的运行将按记录的总量收费；否则，运行将在上限处被终止，其实际运行时间将根据记录的令牌进度进行缩放。 预测处理和时间包含在重播核算中。 对于基于编码器的基线模型，预测令牌计算本地处理的文本；自我预测的计数还包括提供商额外记录的 LLM 使用量。 节省量是相对于相同预算下固定预算策略而言的。 表 20 列出了完整结果，图 8 展示了按预算划分的响应情况，表 21 则比较了预测开销。

paragraphs.en: The following prompt template adapts the zero-shot agent self-prediction protocol of DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 to the four prediction points used in our evaluation. It retains environment inspection, workload analysis, and phase-wise input/output token estimation. At Task Start, the estimator may inspect the initial environment before predicting complete-run consumption. At the other three prediction points, it receives the observed execution record and the target-specific evidence available at that point without advancing the task. Missing fields are marked as not available .
paragraphs.zh: 以下提示词模板将 DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2604-22750 中的零样本智能体自我预测协议，适配到我们评估中使用的四个预测节点。 它保留了环境检查、工作负载分析以及按阶段估算输入/输出标记的功能。 在任务开始时，估算器可以在预测完整运行消耗之前检查初始环境。 在其他三个预测节点上，它会接收已观察到的执行记录以及该时刻可用的特定目标证据，而不会推进任务进程。 缺失的字段会被标记为不可用。

paragraphs.en: The prediction_point field selects one of the four scopes defined above. When the harness exposes a finish tool, completion_instruction requests submission of the JSON estimate through that tool. Otherwise, it requests the same object as the final response. Estimation calls and inspections performed solely for estimation are recorded as prediction overhead. The input and output fields refer to the selected scope, and therefore, predicted_total_tokens represents complete-task consumption at Task Start, complete-call consumption at both call-level points, and remaining-task consumption at Task Update.
paragraphs.zh: prediction_point 字段从上述定义的四个作用域中选择其一。 当测试框架提供一个结束工具时，completion_instruction 会请求通过该工具提交 JSON 估算结果。 否则，它会请求以相同对象作为最终响应。 仅用于估算的估算调用和检查会被记录为预测开销。 输入和输出字段指代所选作用域，因此 predicted_total_tokens 表示任务开始时的完整任务消耗、调用层级两个点的完整调用消耗，以及任务更新时的剩余任务消耗。
